_what: The few commands a reader's own AI may send to steer an open graph picture (graph-live.mjs), as DATA. Each command is a row: `fields` are typed (`text` with a most length, `ids` a list of the document's own ids, `flag`, `list` of items with their own fields, `ops` a list of graph patch operations) and `required` names what must be present. The app only checks every id against the document and relays the result; the AI does the reading and the writing. A node or lane is addressed by its own id, an edge by `from>to`. `answer` leads a reader through steps that each focus on parts of the picture, with `cannot_tell` for an honest 'the document does not say'; `show` focuses without words; `sketch` hangs proposed operations on a copy, never on the document. Adding a command is one row.

errors.UNKNOWN_COMMAND: {path} names the command "{found}"; the commands are {commands}.
errors.UNKNOWN_FIELD: {path} is not a field of this command.
errors.WRONG_TYPE: {path} has the wrong type: {expected} was expected.
errors.UNKNOWN_ID: {path} points at "{found}", which the document does not hold.
